race.comment: WHISPERING ROGUE (1) was terrible last time but would be odds-on from the form prior. Led them up on the Sunshine Coast latest before dropping out and was later vetted and found to have cardiac arrhythmia. Very well placed here on best and happy to give another chance. ESPRIT DU JOUR (4) was a winner five back and not far away in four since. Racing well and is overdue for another win. USUAL LIMITS (11) was an Esk winner two back then not far away at Goondiwindi last time. This tougher but drops in weight and placed only try course and distance. Will push forward and give a sight. ZAINDARA (8) is fitter for two runs back and won't find a better opportunity to fire.
